errors.text_span: мъжете в Чехия със средно 45.64 часа седмично
errors.evidence: Figure shows the average for men in the Czech Republic as 45.64 hours, which is correct, but the description incorrectly implies that this is the highest value when it is not the only mention.

errors.text_span: жените във Финландия работят най-малко - средно по 34.9 часа седмично
errors.evidence: Figure shows the average for women in Finland as 34.9 hours, but there are lower values present in the chart, such as 37 for France.
The description does not clarify that the chart compares working hours by gender across different countries.
The description omits the mention of the type of scale on the vertical axis which is linear.
The description does not mention the grouped structure of the columns for men and women, or the color coding.
The description does not note that the chart has labels indicating the average hours worked on top of each bar.

errors.text_span: „Средностатистически мъжете работят повече часове на седмица от жените“
errors.evidence: This statement is subjective and could imply an interpretation beyond the visual data.
